title: OpenAI Admin API key (sk-admin-): one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 57 bytes after the marker vs the 58 the contract requires and length: 57 bytes before the marker vs the 58 the contract requires. Twin of "OpenAI Admin API key (sk-admin-): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of openai-admin-api-key-curl-bearer: length: 57 bytes after the marker vs the 58 the contract requires. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
